I believe something else is broken also in this release. I get exactly the same error even though the transmission is online. However, re-entering the password will not reconnect.

In log:

`2023-01-05 17:08:46.205 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.transmission] can't connect to transmission daemon: HTTPConnectionPool(host='http', port=80): Max retries exceeded with url: //192.168.1.50:9091/transmission/rpc/:9091/transmission/rpc (Caused by NewConnectionError('<urllib3.connection.HTTPConnection object at 0x7f2fa0a04040>: Failed to establish a new connection: [Errno -2] Name does not resolve'))`

URL seems strange in the log?
mine recoers if i put the password back in, its just annoying that i have to first know that its done this and then find the password for it.

> I believe something else is broken also in this release. I get exactly the same error even though the transmission is online. However, re-entering the password will not reconnect.
> 
> In log:
> 
> `2023-01-05 17:08:46.205 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.transmission] can't connect to transmission daemon: HTTPConnectionPool(host='http', port=80): Max retries exceeded with url: //192.168.1.50:9091/transmission/rpc/:9091/transmission/rpc (Caused by NewConnectionError('<urllib3.connection.HTTPConnection object at 0x7f2fa0a04040>: Failed to establish a new connection: [Errno -2] Name does not resolve'))`
> 
> URL seems strange in the log?

That issue is related to: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/85028

A proper fix is coming, but in the mean time you'll want to delete the integration and re-setup - ensure your host *only* contains just `192.168.1.50` and not `http`, `/transmission/rpc` etc. It worked in 2022.12, but this release changes the underlying library and it doesn't support custom URLs in the hostname.

> A proper fix is coming, but in the mean time you'll want to delete the integration and re-setup - ensure your host _only_ contains just `192.168.1.50` and not `http`, `/transmission/rpc` etc.

FYI, I applied this workaround, entering only the LAN IP and no other URL components such as protocol or path, a couple days ago and today Home Assistant prompted me to re-authenticate to transmission after transmission was down for a bit for unrelated work.  IOW, that workaround doesn't work for me.
